title: Show an operator's own role in the printed status line
action: mrs-26 (commit dc6e0c6d) collapsed status's private copy of the models parser onto the one parser, and reported that it left the job half done in a file outside its cell. Two closed lists survive in the status surface and both make an operator's own role invisible. (1) render.rs around :362-381 prints the human line from a FIXED three-slot format string — Models (claude): generation={} extraction={} review={} — so an operator who adds models.claude.test sees it in bee status --json and NOT in the printed line they actually read. Make the printed line render whatever roles the config carries. Keep it short: this line is read at a glance, so a host with a dozen roles must still produce something a human scans, not a wall — say on the cap how you bounded it. (2) validate_models_config in store.rs walks MODEL_VALIDATE_SLOTS, a closed four-name list in mod.rs:74, so a MALFORMED value under models.claude.test gets no validation warning at all — the operator gets silence for a typo in exactly the shape this feature told them to write. Both are the same defect as the parser copy: a closed list standing where an open set now lives. Verify the current behaviour yourself with the built binary at packages/bee-rs/target/release/bee before and after, so the cap records the real before-state rather than my description. Run your verify with --no-fail-fast.

truths: A role the operator configured outside the historical names appears in the PRINTED status line, not only in --json
The printed line stays scannable for a host with many roles; the cap says how that was bounded
A malformed value under an operator-invented role name is validated and warned like any other
No closed list of role names remains in the status surface

trace.outcome: bee status prints every configured role and validates every configured role
deviations: Bound justification, measured not asserted: the printed role list is capped by a 120-character WIDTH budget, not a role count, then +N more (--json). Measured on the built binary — 12 short-named claude roles cost 153 chars of role text, the same 12 on opencode cost ~380; a count cannot tell those apart. The first suffix spelling (+N more (bee status --json for all)) cost 35 chars to drop 35 chars of short entries, so it was shortened.

Printed order changed and two existing assertions with it: order is now derived (slot_for_kind over DISPATCH_KINDS first, then map order), the same rule hooks::model_guard::role_slot_display uses. extraction reads third rather than second because no dispatch kind resolves it any more.

Fourth defect fixed, same family, one axis over: render.rs printed claude and opencode by hand out of the three RUNTIMES status carries, so a configured models.codex was invisible. A codex line prints when configured; absent when not, so no existing host gains an all-null row.
Reserved and edited one file outside the cell: status_full/build.rs, two call sites, because Problem.slot had to stop being &'static str for an open name set. Reserved under mrs-w27 before writing.

ADVICE_CLASS_SLOTS (advisor/review) deliberately LEFT closed, with the reason in code: those are bee's own door names and read-only is a property of what bee does there, not of any name an operator may choose.
